trigger: Police want to search my phone
description: What to do if an officer asks you to unlock or hand over your phone.

steps.text: Stay calm and polite. Your phone and its contents are private and protected (s.37).
Ask: 'On what legal authority are you searching my phone?'
Ask whether you are being detained, and if so, why.
You are not obliged to unlock your phone simply because you were asked.
Note the officer's name and number, and record what is happening if safe.
If they proceed without lawful authority, call your lawyer.

citations.source_name: 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria
